user.title: Set up OpenIRBlaster
user.description: Select your OpenIRBlaster device from the list below.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure OpenIRBlaster
reconfigure.description: Select the OpenIRBlaster device this entry should be bound to. Use this after renaming the ESPHome device.

error.entity_not_found: The learning mode switch entity was not found. Please ensure your ESPHome device is online and the firmware includes the 'IR Learning Mode' switch.
error.device_not_found: The selected device could not be found in the device registry.
error.service_not_found: The ESPHome send_ir_raw service was not found. Please ensure your ESPHome device is online and the firmware includes the 'send_ir_raw' service.
error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the device

abort.no_devices_found:
No OpenIRBlaster devices found. Please ensure:
1. Your ESPHome device is online and connected
2. The device uses firmware version 0.1.2 or later
3. The firmware includes project name 'jaycollett.openirblaster'
abort.mac_unavailable: The selected device's MAC address could not be determined (its MAC sensor may be unavailable or disabled), so it cannot be verified as the originally configured hardware. Bring the device fully online and try again.
abort.wrong_device: The selected device is different hardware than the one originally configured. To use a different device, add a new integration entry instead.

code_id_ambiguous.message: IR code {code_id} exists on more than one OpenIRBlaster device. Pass config_entry_id to select which one to delete from.

dangling_mac.title: OpenIRBlaster firmware needs an update
dangling_mac.description: The OpenIRBlaster device {device_id} is sending a corrupted MAC address in its learned-code events, which is a known bug in older firmware. Learning still works via device-name matching, but you should update the device firmware to the latest version.

ambiguous_mac_backfill.title: Could not identify the OpenIRBlaster's MAC address
ambiguous_mac_backfill.description: Multiple ESPHome devices match the name {device_id}, so OpenIRBlaster could not determine which MAC address belongs to this entry. The capture-recovery fallback will rely on name matching only. To fix this permanently, reconfigure the integration and select the correct device.

esphome_service_missing.title: OpenIRBlaster cannot send IR codes
esphome_service_missing.description: The ESPHome send service for {name} is no longer available, so IR codes cannot be sent. The device may be offline or was renamed in ESPHome. Check that the device is online, then reload or reconfigure the integration.
